title: Achernar Gas Pocket: hydrogen_gas, argon_gas, plasma_gas, neon_gas; sold at Node Beta Industrial Station
note: Written by routemaker.py from the field's and the book's readings; an estimate of 2579 cr per ship-hour, not a measurement. A test: one ship.
